stories.headline: NVIDIA CHIEF *RESIGNS* AFTER SCANDAL
stories.facts: Jensen Huang stepped down from his roles at Nvidia following an espionage scandal that coincided with a significant drop in market value.
stories.caption_line: 📉 Jensen Huang steps down from Nvidia following an explosive espionage and relationship scandal.
stories.image_prompt: A dramatic portrait of a concerned tech executive in a dark boardroom, glowing stock charts plunging downward in the background, neon blue and orange rim lighting, ultra-detailed photorealistic collage style.
stories.source_title: Jensen Huang resigns as Nvidia CEO after espionage scandal wipes out $1.4 trillion in market value

stories.headline: GOOGLE RELEASES *GEMINI 4* HYDROGEN
stories.facts: Google launched the new Gemini 4 Hydrogen model to better handle intricate requests, typos, and multi-part queries.
stories.caption_line: ⚡ Google releases Gemini 4 Hydrogen to tackle complex searches and multi-part questions.
stories.image_prompt: A glowing quantum server core in a modern data center, floating holographic search bars and neural network lines, vibrant electric-blue and warm-orange palette, cinematic photorealistic lighting.
stories.source_title: Google’s new Gemini model is better at understanding complicated questions

stories.headline: ALPHA GENOME *MAPS* SINGLE CELLS
stories.facts: Google DeepMind introduced AlphaGenome 2, an AI model trained on over 107 million cell profiles to examine genetic variants in individual cell types.
stories.caption_line: 🧬 Google DeepMind's new model maps genetic variants with single-cell resolution.
stories.image_prompt: A glowing microscopic DNA double helix floating in a high-tech laboratory, intricate biological data streams and holographic nodes, electric-blue and amber lighting, photorealistic.
stories.source_title: Google Deepmind shifts genomics AI from bulk tissue predictions to single cell type resolution with AlphaGenome 2

stories.headline: CHATBOTS *DIRECT* USERS TO FAKE SITES
stories.facts: A recent study found that popular AI chatbots frequently guide shoppers toward imposters and risky retail websites.
stories.caption_line: ⚠️ Studies show major AI chatbots are accidentally steering shoppers toward scam websites.
stories.image_prompt: A modern smartphone displaying a glowing warning symbol, digital security shields and blurred online storefronts in the background, dramatic dark lighting with electric-blue accents.
stories.source_title: AI chatbots are recommending fake retail websites, study finds

stories.headline: AUSTRALIA *PROPOSES* AI SAFETY LAWS
stories.facts: The Australian government introduced a new bill aimed at requiring frontier AI developers to undergo mandatory independent audits and safety rules.
stories.caption_line: 🇦🇺 Australia moves to enforce mandatory safety audits and strict rules for frontier AI developers.
stories.image_prompt: A grand government courtroom setting with digital scales of justice glowing in holographic overlay, law documents, dramatic cinematic lighting, electric-blue and warm-orange tones.
stories.source_title: Australia's proposed AI safety bill would force frontier model makers to open up to independent testing

stories.headline: ELEVENLABS *STOPS* AGENT INTERRUPTIONS
stories.facts: ElevenLabs launched Scribe v3 Live, a speech recognition model that uses conversational context to keep voice agents from cutting off users.
stories.caption_line: 🎙️ ElevenLabs updates its speech recognition models to make AI voice agents more conversational.
stories.image_prompt: An abstract visualization of sound waves and audio frequencies glowing in neon blue and orange, modern recording studio background, ultra-detailed photorealistic render.
stories.source_title: ElevenLabs Scribe v3 Live uses conversational context to stop voice agents from cutting off callers mid-sentence

stories.headline: CLAUDE MEETS *DIRECTLY* ON CALLS
stories.facts: Anthropic introduced Claude Meetings in beta, enabling the AI to participate in video calls, draft documents, and generate notes in real time.
stories.caption_line: 🤝 Anthropic brings its AI directly into video calls to generate real-time meeting notes.
stories.image_prompt: A sleek laptop displaying a futuristic video conference interface, floating AI note-taking windows and data nodes, warm studio rim lighting, photorealistic tech carousel slide.
stories.source_title: Claude Meetings lets Anthropic's AI join your video calls
